release_label: 16.1.79 — Stockland Ethiopia ERP cumulative in-place update
classification: Cumulative in-place update on the validated 16.1.78 source line. Simplifies payroll month entry and adds a role-aware line-by-line draft review/edit route through the existing API while preserving Management submission, independent Owner GL approval/payment, statutory payroll rules and the exact 49-table contract.
baseline: Derived from GitHub main source commit 6bb6288633929f020d1869e54e607ee9f3261886 (16.1.78), with the payroll usability changes isolated to the frontend review flow and draft-line validation reuse. No blind ZIP merge, business-data mutation, schema migration or table addition.

schema_contract.migration_policy: In-place, additive schema policy with existing transaction history preserved.

frontend.service_worker_refresh: versioned worker URL + update() on existing registration
frontend.tablet_menu_fix: 576–991px three-row header (identity, dedicated search row, horizontally scrollable action strip); hamburger opens touch-scrollable dialog; Escape/backdrop/selection cleanup reset body lock and aria-expanded; keyboard focus restoration/trap; dismiss overlay on desktop resize.
frontend.global_search_scope: read-only; authenticated ERP profile; capability and authorized location scope; active variants for ordinary users, inactive variants only for stockland_manage_products managers; no customer contacts, balances, costs or profit in returned search labels

frontend_css_architecture.delivery_strategy: One local CSS network request; six maintainable ordered source modules
frontend_css_architecture.responsive_table_rule: sl-responsive-cards tables must include data-label attributes for body cells
frontend_css_architecture.notes: Visual direction is inspired by current business-app design patterns, with Stockland-specific brand and operational behavior. Existing REST routes, data hooks, ledger and schema are preserved.

import_gateway.product_master_variant_ordering: STYLE/SIMPLE rows are committed before VARIANT rows within each bounded chunk

security.fatal_request_uri: Captures request path without query string or fragment
security.rest_nonce_destination: Configured REST API origin and namespace

procurement_controls.external_po_creator: Only active Stockland Management profile may create and submit a Central Warehouse external-supply PO; WordPress Administrator/settings capabilities alone do not authorize creation.
procurement_controls.approval: Independent active Owner profile approves; self-approval is blocked. Legacy APPROVED/PARTIALLY_RECEIVED records require Owner re-review before further receiving.
procurement_controls.warehouse_receipt: Only active Warehouse Manager at Central Warehouse may receive; Warehouse Employee cannot post external supply. Actual accepted quantities alone post; balance remains open on the same PO.
procurement_controls.notifications: Owner is notified on submission; Central Warehouse Manager on Owner approval; Owner and Management receive accepted-quantity/open-balance result after receipt.
procurement_controls.atomicity: PO and PO-item SELECT FOR UPDATE locks, location/business-day locks, stable request key/fingerprint, inventory ledger, GRN lines, balanced PLEDGER/GL journal, PO balance/status and audit are in one receiving transaction.

expense_authority.branch: The active Branch Manager enters and makes the final decision only for the assigned branch. The server derives location from the active ERP profile.
expense_authority.central_warehouse: The active Warehouse Manager enters and makes the final decision only for Central Warehouse.
expense_authority.corporate: Owner and Management record their own corporate expenses without branch attribution. Management submits corporate expenses for the Owner's independent decision. An Owner-created corporate expense remains PENDING and unposted because the creator cannot approve their own expense; it requires a separately authorized independent approver defined by the approved SOP. Both roles can review expense reports, but cannot decide location expenses.
expense_authority.ledger: Location expenses post a balanced GL journal only on the assigned independent final authority approval. Management corporate expenses post their balanced journal on independent Owner approval. Owner-created corporate expenses remain pending and unposted until an approved independent approver exists; the source must fail closed rather than self-post. Rejections require a reason and write audit evidence.

payroll.tax_schedule: Monthly Ethiopian employment-income PAYE schedule under the configured statutory rule version.
payroll.payroll_journal: 6200 payroll expense; 6210 employer pension expense; 2020 payroll payable; 2030 employee pension payable; 2031 income-tax payable; 2032 employer pension payable; 2033 other payroll deductions payable
payroll.posted_payroll_journal_requires: All line-level rule versions present and gross/tax/pension/other deductions/net reconcile to the cent; account codes must be active and of the expected type
payroll.taxable_base: Taxable base = base salary + taxable allowances - employee mandatory pension contribution, floored at zero; employer pension is employer cost and is not an employee deduction.

release_candidate_changes: Finance and Procurement SQL table identifiers consistently resolve through the WordPress-prefixed table resolver, with placeholder order aligned to the corresponding SQL statement.
Branch expense entry and final decisions are limited to the assigned Branch Manager and their branch.
Central Warehouse expenses are limited to the Central Warehouse Manager and Central Warehouse.
Owner and Management corporate expenses have no branch attribution and remain available in reporting.

Management creates and submits external purchase orders using existing active stockable Product Master SKUs, quantities and unit costs; an independent Owner approves; Central Warehouse Manager receives accepted quantities.
Supplier invoice/AP matching, customer AR, payments, stock receiving, ledger postings and audit records retain their separate SOP-controlled stages.
Finance workspace actions and SKU pickers are role-aware, responsive, keyboard-operable and touch-friendly.
The official local Bootstrap 5.3.8 stylesheet and six-module responsive CSS build are bundled without a CDN runtime dependency.
The existing 49-table contract and schema-version markers are unchanged.

Dashboard analytics use a permission-checked, server-scoped read-only endpoint for posted retail sales trends, category totals, branch performance and recent transaction summaries; the response excludes customer/staff PII and profit/cost fields.
Dashboard charts and recent transaction rows render only API-returned posted records; empty and unavailable states are explicit and never fabricate metrics.
Payroll rule v3 deducts the employee's pension contribution from taxable gross components before PAYE calculation, uses a versioned tax-base marker, and adds the ETB 30,000 regression case.
Requisition creation uses a caller-stable request key and a normalized payload fingerprint with lock-protected replay/conflict detection; internal request markers are stripped from UI/API notes.

The Central Warehouse Manager may PICK an Approved requisition without a prior reservation or pickup date; Warehouse Employees may PICK only after the requisition is Reserved. The transaction validates live available stock, uses temporary reservation protection, posts exact quantities through the existing transfer ledger, and records workflow/audit history and notifications.

Requisition drafts show a read-only branch balance and Central Warehouse/peer-branch sourcing preview using live authorized data; lookup failures remain explicit and never create stock or substitute zero values.
Owner-created corporate expenses remain pending and unposted until an independent authority is defined; no self-approval or direct Owner GL self-post is allowed.

The top header adds an always-visible global search across active Product Master SKU/variant records plus inactive variants only for Product Master managers, permitted customers, location-scoped retail sales and authorized purchase orders; results return safe labels/references, prefix-match identifiers and preserve role/location scope.
Mobile and tablet header layout reserves its own responsive search row without replacing the existing mega-menu, command palette, SOP, alerts or profile controls.
Dashboard composition now matches the agreed three-panel desktop analytics row and right-rail activity placement; exact-host acceptance remains PENDING.
16.1.79: Payroll period creation uses one month picker and deterministically derives the YYYY-MM key, first date and actual calendar month-end, avoiding manual date/key mismatch.

16.1.79: Payroll period rows open a single responsive review view with employee-level base, taxable/exempt allowance, PAYE, employee pension, other deductions, net pay and calculation status from the existing payroll REST detail response.

16.1.79: Management can edit only DRAFT payroll lines; edits call the existing server calculator and transactional audit endpoint. Legacy/stale-rule lines must be recalculated and reclassified before submission.

16.1.79: The review view gates Management submission, independent Owner approval/GL posting and separate Owner bank/cash payment by current period status and existing role capabilities; approval and payment require explicit confirmation.

16.1.79: A line edit can reuse a currently calculated, current-rule non-standard pensionable salary classification only when the pensionable amount is unchanged. New, legacy, stale-rule or changed non-standard amounts still require a documented legal/contract basis.
16.1.79: Existing statutory rates, rule version ET-PAYE-1395-2025-v3-PENSION-BASE, pension-first PAYE calculation, RETAINER_SERVICE exclusion and 49-table/database schema versions remain unchanged.
